title: High-precision Radiosurgery Followed by Minimally Invasive Surgical Approach in Patients With High-prominence Uveal Melanoma: Modern Radiation Techniques and Outcomes
official: High-precision Radiosurgery Followed by Minimally Invasive Surgical Approach in Patients With High-prominence Uveal Melanoma: Modern Radiation Techniques and Outcomes; PRIME: P: Precision R: Radiosurgery I: Intervention M: Minimal Invasive Surgical Approach E: EYESIGHT
summary: High-precision radiosurgery followed by minimally invasive surgical approach in patients with high-prominence uveal melanomas: modern radiation techniques and outcomes. Evaluation of outcome regarding multiparametric parameters and co-factors
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Functional Resectability,
* Technical Resectability
* high-prominent uveal melanoma

Exclusion Criteria:

* EOE
* At least in part remaining eye function that can be saved
